name: Pfefernoddex
subtitle: Danish Christmas Cookies
notes:
Laborious to make, yet dangerously addictive!

If you really love someone, give as a gift, wrapped in a new dishcloth and placed in a pretty bowl! Otherwise, store in an airtight container and serve sometime after Christmas while playing games around the table.

items: More flour as needed to make a stiff dough

steps.title: Cream the butter and sugar
steps.body: Cream together **¾ pound butter** (3 cubes) and **2 cups sugar**.

steps.title: Mix in the dry ingredients
steps.body: Add and mix with a wooden spoon or dough hook: **4 cups flour**, **1 heaping tsp ginger**, **1 tsp cinnamon**, **½ tsp cloves** and **½ tsp salt**, plus more flour as needed to make a stiff dough.

steps.title: Shape the ropes
steps.body: Roll into ½-inch ropes and cut into ⅛–¼-inch slices (often easier after chilling the ropes in the freezer but not totally freezing them).

steps.title: Bake
steps.body: Place on a baking sheet, allowing for some expansion. Bake at 350°F for 15 minutes.
